Name: Luny's Farm Dresses for FS
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
This is my first mod, but I tried my best with it! It adds a custom shirt and skirt to Fashion Sense, themed around a farming cottagecore aesthetic. I might add a 2nd version using Malon's colors and pattern from Ocarina of Time, since the outfit is very similar. :3

All pieces are now completely dyeable! The skirt and apron can be dyed separately, as well as the shirt, scarf tie, and apron band.

I originally designed this for myself, but I figured I'd share it for anyone else who's looking for the same style. I did design this with long hair in mind, so I spent more time adjusting the front and side views. The back looks a little odd to me with short hair, but I also think the sprites look weird in general from the back, so maybe others will think it looks fine.

If you are interested in this, I hope you enjoy it! ^-^


To install:
Unzip the file and drop the contents into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. Only works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]!


If you'd like to see updates on my projects, check out [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]my page on Kofi[/url]! You can also buy me a coffee if you like, but don't feel obligated!
